name: com.sipdroid.codecs.Codecs$CodecSettings
description: When someone changes call audio settings, the NXCloud SIP calling SDK opens this page. Users can choose whether each voice format is used only on Wi-Fi, on Wi-Fi and mobile data, always tried, or never used, and change the order in which formats are tried.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to change when each voice format can be used or its priority for calls.
